header: THE SAVED TRAINS OF THE KOLKATA TERMINALS (Howrah, Sealdah, Santragachi, Kolkata) THAT GO OVER NEITHER DURGAPUR NOR ASANSOL, with their fares (src/lib/live/kolkataSet.ts says which trains these are). Three tables, closed to the public roles like the other fare tables (src/lib/nl2sql/sql/32_train_kol.sql): public.train_kol the CATALOGUE: one row for every train that STARTS at one of the four stations, whether it is in the set or not (in_set, and the reason when it is out), with its details and its halts with times; public.train_fare_kol the fare of each class from the starting station to the END of the run, one row per train (the same shape as train_fare, with from_code because the starting station differs); public.train_fare_leg_kol the fare to EVERY halt after the starting station, one row per train and halt (the same shape as train_fare_leg). Everything has the time it was received. The fares are the railway's reservation system's own, through RailRadar's paid fare service (to 14 Dec 2026). Nothing here is personal data. I made these tables of their own, and did not widen FareStation (fareStore.ts), so that nothing about the Durgapur and Asansol tabs can change.
